xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatementByDirectorResponsible:
I am pleased to present Accelya’s Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, highlighting another year of progress in embedding sustainability across our business and strengthening our contribution to a more sustainable aviation industry.
As a trusted technology partner to airlines worldwide, we recognize that ESG is fundamental to building resilience, managing risk, creating long-term value, and supporting our customers through the industry's transition to a lower-carbon future.
This year, we focused on translating our ESG strategy into measurable outcomes.
Key achievements include:
Delivering a supplier carbon engagement programme covering 27 key suppliers, representing 61% of total procurement spend. Expanding the scope of our ISO 14001 certification, strengthening environmental management across our global operations. Increasing our EcoVadis score to 74/100, placing Accelya in the top 9% of more than 150,000 companies assessed globally. Reducing total greenhouse gas emissions by 14% year-on-year. Achieving a 36% reduction in office emissions through increased renewable electricity use and Renewable Energy Certificate coverage. Delivering a 62% reduction in non-cloud data centre emissions through enhanced supplier engagement and improved emissions data quality. Offsetting 100% of FY24 emissions in accordance with the Certified Carbon Neutral Standard while maintaining a strong focus on absolute emissions reduction. While we are proud of the progress made, we recognize that significant work remains. Climate change, evolving stakeholder expectations, and increasing regulatory requirements continue to shape our operating environment. In response, we remain focused on integrating sustainability more deeply into our business strategy, strengthening value-chain engagement, and supporting our airline customers in achieving their own sustainability ambitions. Looking ahead, our focus will be on accelerating decarbonization, strengthening engagement across our value chain, and further embedding sustainability into business decision-making. By continuing to align ESG performance with business strategy, we aim to create long-term value for our stakeholders while supporting the aviation industry's transition to a more sustainable and resilient future. I would like to thank our employees, customers, suppliers, and stakeholders for their continued support and partnership as we work together to create a more sustainable future.

Any grievance to be reported to either an HR official / immediate superior / Business Unit Head.
The HR official / immediate superior / Business Unit Head should meet the complainant on the same working day and record the grievance.
Depending on the seriousness and consequences of the grievance, the concerned official has to decide on the resolution or further course of action as:
If the issue can be resolved by dialogue, the same must be done within 3 working days and must be documented with HR.
If the issue requires intervention by a senior grade member or HR, a committee of three members (with at least one female representative) must be formed within 5 working days and the issue must be documented at all the levels of dialogue.
While investigating, the committee will follow principles of natural justice and provide opportunity to both sides to put forward their case and explanation/evidence.
The decision of grievance handling committee shall be final and any action/reprimand will be commensurate to the offence.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfOccupationalHealthAnd: We have the required health & safety systems and equipment installed and placed in accessible locations in the facility premises (e.g., HVAC, Fire system, Wheelchairs, Stretchers, Basic first-aid kits, Drinking water, Indoor air quality, Fire & safety training on emergency preparedness).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DesclosureOfTheProcessesUsedTo:
1) We perform indoor air quality testing once in two years,
2) We ensure use of R407c, R410, R314a Gas in HVAC & VRF systems.
3) We have installed Electrostatic filters in AHU and carry out monthly cleaning of filters.
4) We have installed UV lights in HVAC system for destroying fungal bacteria.
5) We perform maintenance and servicing of electrical equipment every month and maintenance of electrical panels on yearly basis.
6) We perform hygiene of washrooms and reception every one hour.
7) We perform disinfection and cleaning on of workstations on daily basis after close of business hours.

Incident Management Problem Management Technical support

Telephone call; Email; or Ticketing tool
